name: Lolicon Kyoushi Itazura Nikki ~Muku na Anoko ni Seikyouiku~
original_name: ロリコン教師悪戯日記～無垢なあの子に性教育～
source:
The main character who likes kids one day happened to get into action with his student.

The girl is so innocent that she is trained with many sexual lessons by the main character obediently.
